'''2009 Bespin Regionals Dan Albright LS Hoth: Main Power Generators''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Dan Albright]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif|label=Hoth: Main Power Generators}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Dann Albright
* '''Deck name:''' The Disappearing Sun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
